newsitem.title: USA: Hutchinson picks Sioux Falls for new plant.
newsitem.headline: Hutchinson picks Sioux Falls for new plant.

text.p: Hutchinson Technology Inc said Thursday it picked Sioux Falls, S.D. to be the site for a new assembly manufacturing facility.
Construction, with costs estimated at $35 million to $40 million, is expected to begin later this year. Current plans call for the facility to be operating about 12 months after construction begins.
Hutchinson said the new plant could increase its Sioux Falls area employment to 2,500 or more within two to three years of startup. It now employs more than 1,500 people in the area.
Hutchinson said the new assembly facility is needed to provide capacity required to meet growing demand for the company's suspension assemblies for hard disk drives.
